prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 67-year-old woman with a silver pixie haircut and oval glasses stands beside her almost empty office desk on retirement day. Two adult colleagues, a clean-shaven dark-haired man and a red-haired woman, present a plain wrapped gift. A box of personal belongings rests on the desk. Capture their affectionate moment in soft office window light; no cake or party table. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional composition and anatomy requirements: Exact 16:9 wide photograph. Exactly three people stand in a compact central grouping; place the retirement gift, all six hands and all three faces safely within the central 60 percent width so both central crops retain the complete moment. Leave quiet believable office context on both sides. The silver-haired retiree is petite, the male colleague is tall and lean, the red-haired female colleague has a fuller build.
review: Reviewed full wide photo: exactly three distinct colleagues, a petite silver-haired retiree in glasses, tall dark-haired man and fuller red-haired woman, share a wrapped gift beside an office desk and belongings box. Faces and important hands are plausible and central; gift, shoulder gesture and expressions survive both central crops. PNG 1672x941.
